mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_chat_session (user_id, title, last_message, message_count, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{userId}, #{title}, #{lastMessage}, #{messageCount}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, title, last_message, message_count, create_time, update_time FROM ai_chat_session WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY update_time DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_chat_session SET title = #{title}, last_message = #{lastMessage}, message_count = #{messageCount}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
